name: usb-rea
description: Reverse engineers USB devices that only ship a Windows vendor app: records usbmon/USBPcap captures, labels each action, infers the protocol (command ids, values, lookup tables, counters, checksums, device replies, opening handshake) with frame-level evidence, and generates a Python/pyusb driver and a Wireshark dissector. Replaying packets to a device requires explicit confirmation.
